report.scope: PBI-011 (review findings ledger, FR-111, FR-112, AC-77): derive review-lane findings from a run's structured JSON result in exporters/derive.py (F-1), publish them per project as projectTabs/<id>.findings via exporters/export_sessions.py (F-2), and add a findings ledger view to site/index.html (F-3), pinning AC-77 and the empty case; ran-suite grounding, all three configured suites executed locally.
report.summary: 3 files modified under exporters/ and site/, 3 test files modified under tests/; python -m unittest discover -s tests: 322 passed / 0 failed (was 307); node tests/page.test.mjs: 99 passed / 0 failed (was 96); python -m unittest discover -s local/tests: 194 passed / 0 failed, unchanged; nothing committed, staged or pushed.

changes.why: F-1: add findings_of() (parses a review-lane run's trailing fenced JSON findings block, tolerant of no block or malformed JSON) and findings_doc() (groups a project's finished cr-lane rounds per work item into open/resolved findings, rounds, roundsToGo); agent_row() now attaches findings_of() to a cr-lane row's own findings list, kept off the published run document

F-2: write one projectTabs/<projectId>.findings document per project with at least one finished code-review round, reusing the existing projectTabs folder/collection (no new collection, refresh.py's guards untouched)

F-3: add a Findings ledger tab/panel fed by projectTabs/<id>.findings, per work item showing open findings (--changes), resolved findings (--go) and review rounds (with rounds-to-GO once reached), all text through esc()/md(); the empty case (no findings document) says so and renders no error

unit tests for findings_of() (no JSON, malformed JSON, text after the fence, empty findings list, file:line from subject) and findings_doc() (AC-77's two-round scenario, roundsToGo, rows outside the cr lane or with no PBI id, a still-running or cut-off review not yet a round)

end-to-end tests over synthetic transcripts: AC-77's exact projectTabs/<id>.findings shape, the roundsToGo case, no findings document when a project has no finished review round, and run documents carrying no findings field
pins AC-77 on the page (F1 and F3 resolved, F2 open, 2 rounds), the rounds-to-GO case, and the empty case (no findings document: the view says so, no console.error)

tests.covers: findings_of() parsing tolerance and file:line extraction
findings_doc() grouping, AC-77, roundsToGo, running/killed reviews excluded
the exported projectTabs/<id>.findings document, AC-77, the no-document case, run documents unchanged

not_done.reason: out of scope per the PBI (explicitly named): the new projectTabs/<id>.findings entry is left for a follow-up docs chore

local/** is outside this work item's allowed areas. The local-first app's tab id form only accepts spec/assumptions/decisions/backlog/git, so a projectTabs/<id>.findings document would fail local/records.store_path()/validate() once the local server actually holds one. Today's local/tests conformance fixture never produces a code-review round with structured findings, so its 194 tests stay green unchanged, but this is a real gap for whichever PBI next touches local/records.py: it should add 'findings' to TAB_NAMES and give the 'tab' SHAPES entry the items field.

follow_ups.ref: local/records.py: add 'findings' to TAB_NAMES (and, if felt worth it, an 'items' shape hint) so the local-first app can hold a findings tab without failing its id-form check
CLAUDE.md: document the projectTabs/<projectId>.findings store path (written by export_sessions.py, not export_board.py, since it derives from run transcripts rather than repo files)
